item.title: Tropical threat brewing off Mexico could impact Gulf Coast this weekend
item.description: Tropical Depression Nine formed in the Gulf, and a lot remains unknown.

item.title: California couple at center of surrogacy scandal arrested
item.description: Guojun Xuan and Silvia Zhang, who had at least 25 children via surrogates, were arrested at their home in Arcadia, California.

item.title: Former Cornell frat members ask university to clear their names
item.description: Some former Cornell University students say they are being falsely connected to a 2024 sexual assault​​ and targeted online.

item.title: Hearing over effort to deport Kilmar Abrego Garcia to Liberia abruptly canceled
item.description: A hearing before a federal judge over whether Kilmar Abrego Garcia can be deported to Liberia was abruptly canceled on Tuesday.

item.title: Watch: Historic student protests sweeping across France
item.description: Students, teachers and parents continued protesting against poor school conditions in France for a third week. Videos captured throngs of demonstrators marching, with some clashing with law enforcement on a historic day of protest on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran's Houthi allies deny losing ground as Mideast crisis engulfs Yemen
item.description: Iran's Houthi allies deny losing ground to Yemen's Saudi-backed military, but oil prices ease despite the Middle East crisis erupting in a battle over control of another key waterway.

item.title: Olympian accused of damaging Reflecting Pool seeks probe of potential misconduct
item.description: David Hearn is asking the Justice and Interior Dept. inspectors general to investigate his arrest and the dismissal of the case against him.

item.title: Trump says he'll start paying for ads after pushback over taxpayer funding
item.description: President Trump says he'll start paying for the pro-Trump ads that have blanketed the airwaves in recent weeks, using money from his super PAC instead of taxpayer dollars.

item.title: ABC asks judge to block FCC early license review
item.description: An ABC lawyer argued the FCC was effectively forcing the broadcast company to sit with its "head on a guillotine" while it awaits a decision about its license renewals.

item.title: Ex-CIA official found with $40 million in gold bars admits to sprawling scheme
item.description: A former CIA official admitted to inventing fake classified programs to divert nearly $200 million in government money that was used to buy Florida mansions and gold bars.

item.title: Cornell taps Sally Yates to lead review of its response to sexual misconduct claims
item.description: Cornell University said Tuesday it is bringing on a former Justice Department official to review its handling of sexual misconduct claims, including the alleged 2024 sexual assault of a former student at a fraternity house​.

item.title: What to know about plague amid reports of worker death at Russian lab
item.description: Reports of a lab worker dying in Russia after allegedly being exposed to plague have raised concerns, even as the WHO says the public health risk is low.

item.title: GOP Super PAC pours $5 million into South Carolina Senate race, sources say
item.description: The influx of cash comes as President Trump escalated the attacks against Darline Graham's Democratic opponent, Annie Andrews.

item.title: Backlash over new bodycam footage of cheerleader's arrest in Arizona
item.description: New bodycam video has been released of an Arizona State University cheerleader's arrest and it's sparking backlash about the police officer's use of force. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has more.

item.title: Trump temporarily expands use of red-dyed diesel. Will it lower costs?
item.description: Experts say the new executive order will have a limited impact on farmers and truckers who rely on diesel.

item.title: Paramount closes $110 billion deal to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: The merger unites two major movie studios, news operations CBS News and CNN and cable networks including Comedy Central and TNT.

item.title: Doctor says he warned Christa Pike's lawyers that her execution could be cruel and painful
item.description: Dr. Joel Zivot, an anesthesiologist, was retained by Christa Pike's legal team as a medical expert and says he warned them after reviewing her medical records that the execution attempt on her could be painful and cruel. Zivot joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Newly released footage of Tempe woman's arrest sparks backlash over use of force
item.description: Newly released footage of a Tempe, Arizona, police officer arresting a woman has sparked backlash for disputing the initial claims about how forceful he was. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has the latest.

item.title: Israel prepares to mark 3 years since October 7 Hamas attacks
item.description: Wednesday will mark three years since Hamas' October 7 attacks against Israel. CBS News senior reporter Dov Lieber reports.

item.title: U.K. arrests 7th man on suspicion of terrorism over air base incident
item.description: Police have now detained seven people, and released six on bail, in connection with the incident near an air base used by U.S. warplanes that President Trump and Britain's leader say has Iran links.

item.title: Trump suggests letting Iran "take out" LA, San Diego during rally
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom called President Trump "deranged and dangerous" after he suggested letting Iran "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego.

item.title: Amelia Earhart investigators to study mysterious object in Pacific
item.description: Investigators have begun an expedition to study a mysterious "visual anomaly" that they say may be Amelia Earhart's long-lost plane.

item.title: Tips on how to be liked from a behavorial researcher
item.description: Behavioral researcher Vanessa Van Edwards joins "CBS Mornings" to discuss her new book, "Conversation: How to Connect with Anyone & Make Every Interaction Count," which offers tips for anyone looking to improve their people skills.

item.title: Why you just got a $90 Social Security check — and who missed out
item.description: Millions of seniors are getting $90 direct deposits from Social Security this week, prompting questions about the source of the money.

item.title: Mexico arrests alleged cartel leader and fuel smuggler "The Tank"
item.description: Authorities say "El Tanque" runs a massive fuel theft network and is linked to homicides, kidnappings and drug trafficking.

item.title: Hispanic voters moving towards Democrats, CBS News poll shows
item.description: Hispanic and Latino voters are veering towards the Democratic Party, a recent CBS News poll shows. This comes amid rising frustrations over the Trump administration's handling of the economy and harsh immigration policies. The Wall Street Journal national politics reporter, Sabrina Rodriguez, shares her thoughts on the midterm elections.

item.title: Extended cut: Heroic FlyDubai passengers recall tense moments after pilot was stabbed
item.description: A routine flight became a fight for survival when the co-pilot attacked the captain and tried to crash FlyDubai Flight 1073. As the plane plunged 14,000 feet, people on board helped subdue the attacker while another pilot regained control. Correspondent Matt Gutman sat down with some of the heroes who helped avert disaster.

item.title: Jim Bakker, who co-founded "The PTL Club" but fell into disgrace, dies at 86
item.description: Jim Bakker, who along with his first wife Tammy Faye built an evangelical empire around "The PTL Club" TV show, only to lose it all over a sex scandal and financial crimes, has died at 86.

item.title: What to know after U.S. Marine arrested for murder in Japan
item.description: Police said they arrested Lance Cpl. Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, on suspicion of strangling Anna Yagi, 39, at a hotel.

item.title: War-damaged Gaza building collapses, killing at least 20 people
item.description: Health officials in Gaza say a building damaged months ago by an Israeli strike has collapsed, killing people from 6 displaced families who had taken shelter inside.
